page.heading: Skills
page.subtitle: Reusable rule blocks. Attach them to agents to shape how a review is done.

empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Import a skill from a file, a URL, or the community catalog.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to preview its body.

drawer.title: Import a skill
drawer.subtitle: Upload a markdown file or a zip archive — nothing is saved until you confirm

editor.title: Create a skill
editor.subtitle: A skill is text only — a rule block that becomes part of an agent's prompt
editor.descriptionPlaceholder: Use when a diff adds or changes tests…
editor.descriptionHint: This is the skill's interface — it is what you (and the agent) read to decide whether the skill applies. Write it directively: "Use when …, then …".
editor.bodyPlaceholder:
## my-rule

What to check, and what to report…
editor.bodyHint: Inserted verbatim into the agent's prompt, in the order the agent's Skills tab defines.

import.importedToast: Imported "{name}" — disabled until you enable it.
import.trustWarning: This body becomes instructions inside your agent's prompt — the same standing as the prompt you wrote yourself. Read it before enabling the skill. It is imported disabled.

dropzone.title: Drop a skill file here
dropzone.hint: A .md file, or a .zip containing a SKILL.md. Executable files in an archive are never read.

errors.unreadable: Could not read that file. Upload a .md file or a .zip containing one.

file.nameHint: Optional — derived from the first heading if blank.
file.bodyHint: This text becomes instructions inside your agent's prompt. Read it before you enable the skill.

url.label: Skill URL
url.hint: Fetched server-side, stored as untrusted, and left disabled until vetted.
url.success: Imported "{name}". Disabled until you vet + enable it.

preview.title: Preview
preview.subtitle: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.
preview.deleteConfirm: Delete skill "{name}"? It will be detached from every agent that links it.
preview.untrustedNotice: This skill came from outside your workspace. Its body is added to the agent's prompt as instructions, so read it in full before enabling it.
preview.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.

versions.title: Version history
versions.subtitle: Every save snapshots the body so eval runs stay reproducible against the exact text they scored.
versions.diffTooLarge: This change is too large to diff in the browser.
